stories.title: Follow live: Defenses on top in tight Ravens-Falcons contest
Commanders botch last play in OT, resulting in tie; 'It's on me,' Daniels says
stories.summary: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels said of the chaotic final seconds that prevented his team from attempting a winning field goal, "Ultimately, it's on me."

stories.title: Packers let play do talking, then roast Bears' Burden after win: 'He quit'
stories.summary: Zaire Franklin had some strong words for Luther Burden -- even if he didn't mention him by name -- after the Packers' 31-7 win over the Bears at Lambeau Field.

stories.title: Texans trade for Cardinals' Harrison, reunite WR with QB Stroud
stories.summary: The Texans completed a trade for Cardinals wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr., coach DeMeco Ryans told reporters.

stories.title: 49ers' Greenlaw ejected after head-butting helmetless Jones in win vs. Seahawks
stories.summary: Dre Greenlaw was ejected in the second quarter of Sunday's divisional showdown with the Seahawks after a late hit and an ensuing head-butt.
